Maya: Quick UX nit — the encryption pill in Instance details is confusing. Users ask if it means BYOK vs just 'data encrypted at rest'. :thinking_face:
Sam: Are you referring to the label or the tooltip behavior?
Maya: Both. Right now it reads 'Encrypted (KMS)' which looks like a key is attached but doesn't distinguish alias vs key id. On small screens the tooltip is hard to reach by keyboard.
Devon: Agreed. KMS key id is noisy. We should surface the alias and provide an affordance to expand to full key id.
Aisha: From a security POV alias alone can be ambiguous unless we show authority. Recommend format: "Encrypted — AWS KMS: alias/my-service-key" with an info chevron that reveals key id + last rotation.
Sam: Mock idea: pill shows two lines on hover/focus: line1 = Encryption · AWS KMS, line2 (smaller) = alias/my-service-key. Keyboard focus should mirror hover content.
Oliver: Audit logs need consistent verbs. Right now we have mixed copy: "encryption key updated" vs "KMS key rotated". Standardize verbs to created/updated/rotated/deleted. Also include tz in ISO + human friendly.
Maya: Also noticed retention presets labeled 'Short/Default/Long' — testers were confused about actual durations. Can we inline the durations like 'Short (7d)'? Ensure that duration text is exposed to screen readers.
Devon: Easy enough. Add parentheses durations and attach aria-describedby on preset buttons with readable text.
Aisha: Please ensure retention changes are logged with previous_value -> new_value. Right now audit only records new value, which blocks investigations.
Sam: Proposed follow-ups: 1) Rename pill to 'Encryption (AWS KMS)' and show alias. 2) Add keyboard-expand affordance to reveal full key id and rotation ts. 3) Retention presets: show durations inline and include sr-only descriptions. 4) Audit copy: standardize verb list and include previous_value in change events.
Maya: I'll update the Figma mock and annotate accessibility notes. @Devon can you confirm the popup won't cause layout shift in compact panels? :eyes:
Devon: Prototype plan: absolute-position panel, animate via transform to avoid reflow. Shouldn't shift layout. Will drop a quick demo.
Oliver: I'll write a short doc for audit copy: pattern = "[actor] [verb] [resource] — from [old] to [new] (2024-XX-XXT.. tz)". Will propose verb whitelist.
ux-bot: Reminder — design review sync Fri 10am. Added this thread to the agenda.
Maya: Thanks all — I'll file follow-up tickets for accessibility and audit changes after the mock is in Figma.
